ko.title: 야옹 멍멍 짝짝 🐱🐶 | 고양이 강아지 동요 | 모모타임
ko.description:
고양이 야옹! 강아지 멍멍! 모모와 함께 따라 부르고 짝짝 박수쳐요. 2~4세 아이들을 위한 짧고 신나는 동물 동요입니다.

함께 배워요:
• 고양이를 보고 고양이라고 말해요.
• 강아지를 보고 강아지라고 말해요.
• 야옹·멍멍 소리를 따라 하고 박수로 리듬을 느껴요.

모모타임과 즐겁게 노래해요!

#모모타임 #동요 #유아동요 #동물동요 #고양이 #강아지 #아기동요 #한국어동요 #박수동요 #MomoTime

approvals: 2026-11-06 사용자: 한국어도 가야지 — 같은 동물 주제의 한국어판 제작 요청.
notes.production_request: 2026-11-06 사용자: 한국어도 가야지 — ep14 고양이·강아지의 한국어 짝곡 제작 요청.
notes.production_direction: 2~4세, 고양이·강아지 두 단어, 쉬운 단문·야옹/멍멍 반복·짝짝 박수. 밝고 가벼운 여성 보컬, 이전 톡톡 통통 챈트 선호 반영. 영어곡과 다른 한국어 원곡.
notes.visual_reuse: Reuse six approved ep14 source scenes; zero new Higgsfield generations. No lip sync; 고양이/강아지 one keyword per animal shot; no label on Momo dance/clap.
notes.user_discretion: Latest user instruction permits judgment over mechanical runbook gates; inspect and proceed within existing scope. Suno official download requires_credit still needs its required response-specific confirmation.

download_preflight.rate_limit_note: Second preflight was rate-limited for 1s; retried once after more than 5s, succeeded without charge.
download_preflight.superseded_by: Both v1 candidates rejected; no download approved or charged.

suno_generation_history.user_feedback: 둘다 별로네; 리듬·후렴 — 더 신나고 귀에 남게

notes.user_feedback_2026_11_06: 한국어 v1 두 곡 모두 불만족. 수정 우선순위: 리듬·후렴 — 더 신나고 귀에 남게. 보컬 변경 요구는 없음.
notes.revision02_direction: Onomatopoeia first, two-bar call and name response, clear short/held-note contrast, recurring clap refrain, stronger bouncing bass/clap groove at target 124 BPM without fast lyric delivery. Same two learning words; original composition.

suno_generation.review_source: Official Suno audio-listen and audio-analysis; not a user approval or direct local listening.

review_summary.take1: More distinct pitch leaps, bouncing bass and call/response; clear names and breathing room per automatic listening. Repetition remains, ending may sound abrupt. Needs local end check if selected.
review_summary.take2: Simple narrow-range repeated hook and contrasting clap section; clear names and smooth end per automatic listening. Less hook variety and limited echo space.
review_summary.uncertainty: Automatic listening is advisory. Take 1 outro timestamps are inconsistent; take 2 JSON outro_s=64.042 conflicts with 74s total and last_vocal_s=69.077, so it is invalid. Do not use these values for edit timing.

notes.revision03_direction: After automatic listening flagged limited hook contrast, use an explicit short-short-long four-note vocal motif, whole-bar lines with a breath, bass dropout under the four-bar clap section and a clear bass return. One further basic generation request; maintain bright light female vocal, Korean cat/dog words and zero new visual generation.
